/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,sqlite3,collections
packet=json.load(open('packet.json'))
conn=sqlite3.connect('file:database.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
def lit(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace(\"'\",\"''\")+\"'\"
columns={'document':'d.number','final_document':'d.number','disposition':'x.code','wg_meeting':'m.label','cr_pack':'p.pack_number','tsg_meeting':'p.tsg_meeting','clause':'s.clause'}
decision_joins='JOIN disposition AS x ON x.target = d.id JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = x.resolution_id JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id'
pack_joins='JOIN cr_in_pack AS cp ON cp.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id'
section_joins='JOIN cr_modifies_section AS cs ON cs.cr = d.id JOIN section AS s ON s.id = cs.section_id'
verified=[\"x.evidence_status = 'source_verified'\", \"x.scope = 'whole_target'\", \"m.wg = 'RAN2'\"]
output=[]
counts=collections.defaultdict(list)
empty=[]
for item in packet['items']:
    question=item['question']
    prefix=''
    joins=[]
    conditions=[]
    if question.startswith('Which Rel-'):
        family='clause'
        release,clause,spec=re.search(r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause (.*?) of TS ([\\d.]+) have',question).groups()
        joins=[decision_joins,pack_joins,section_joins]
        conditions=verified+[\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\",'d.target_release = '+lit(release),'d.spec = '+lit(spec),'s.spec = '+lit(spec),'s.release = '+lit(release),'s.clause = '+lit(clause)]
    elif question.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack'):
        family='members'
        pack=re.search(r'RP-\\d+',question).group()
        joins=[pack_joins,decision_joins]
        conditions=verified+[\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\",'p.pack_number = '+lit(pack)]
    elif question.startswith('RAN2 recorded document'):
        family='revision'
        start=re.search(r'R2-\\d+',question).group()
        prefix='WITH RECURSIVE later_versions(id) AS (SELECT rv.later FROM revision AS rv JOIN document AS source ON source.id = rv.earlier WHERE source.number = '+lit(start)+' UNION SELECT rv.later FROM revision AS rv JOIN later_versions AS lv ON lv.id = rv.earlier) '
        joins=['JOIN later_versions AS lv ON lv.id = d.id',decision_joins,pack_joins]
        conditions=verified+['d.number <> '+lit(start)]
    elif question.startswith(('Change request','Trace change request','In which')):
        number,cr_number,spec=re.search(r'(R2-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\)',question).groups()
        conditions=['d.number = '+lit(number),'d.cr_number = '+lit(cr_number),'d.spec = '+lit(spec),\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\"]
        if question.startswith('In which'):
            family='pack'
            joins=[pack_joins]
        else:
            family='trace' if question.startswith('Trace') else 'decision'
            joins=[decision_joins,pack_joins]
            conditions+=verified
            if family=='trace':
                joins.append(section_joins)
                conditions.append('s.spec = '+lit(spec))
    else:
        raise ValueError('Unhandled item '+item['id'])
    projection=', '.join(columns[field]+' AS \"'+field+'\"' for field in item['fields'])
    sql=prefix+'SELECT DISTINCT '+projection+' FROM document AS d '+' '.join(joins)+' WHERE '+' AND '.join(conditions)+';'
    cursor=conn.execute(sql)
    assert [c[0] for c in cursor.description]==item['fields'],item['id']
    rows=cursor.fetchall()
    counts[family].append(len(rows))
    if not rows:
        empty.append(item['id'])
    output.append({'id':item['id'],'sql':sql})
with open('queries.jsonl','w') as stream:
    for row in output:
        stream.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
with open('queries.jsonl') as stream:
    lines=stream.readlines()
assert len(lines)==len(packet['items'])
parsed=[json.loads(line) for line in lines]
assert all(set(row)=={'id','sql'} for row in parsed)
assert [row['id'] for row in parsed]==[item['id'] for item in packet['items']]
assert all(isinstance(row['sql'],str) for row in parsed)
print('Lines written:',len(lines))
print('Check: passed')
print('Executed queries:',len(output))
print('Family result row ranges:',{k:[min(v),max(v)] for k,v in counts.items()})
print('Empty results:',empty)
PY"
